deliverableCompleteness.notes: All required deliverables present: ui-ux-audit-report.md (146 lines, 4 findings + 6 recommendations), ui-baseline-metrics.json (all required fields), 9/9 tasks completed, 11/11 ACs satisfied.

evidenceQuality.notes: Audit findings cite specific files and line counts (e.g., 'admin/ai-tools.astro: 58 hardcoded px values'). Severity ratings justified. Intentional patterns (JS event handlers, raw labels in islands) are correctly classified as Low severity.

actionability.notes: Recommendations are concrete and prioritized P0/P1/P2. P0 fixes specify exact split boundaries (e.g., 'ProductsIsland.astro: 828 lines → 3 islands: ProductTableIsland, ProductFormIsland, ProductGalleryIsland'). P1 includes specific page list. P2 includes fix pattern (e.g., 'use w-[18px] for arbitrary values').

baselineUtility.notes: ui-baseline-metrics.json structured for delta computation. All numeric fields (totalViolations, rawButtonCount, hardcodedPxCount, darkModeCoverage.percentage) can be diffed against post-refactor measurements. AC-0159-US3-02 satisfied.
